Subject: Your cross-border insolvency matter

Dear Mr. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 24 January 2020 about your dispute with Malhotra Industries. As we understand it, the foreign administrator wants control of the assets in this country. The matter is listed before the NCLT Mumbai.

Our advice is to seek recognition of the foreign insolvency proceeding. Please collect the foreign court's order and the list of local assets and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
